Generated by hack/demosvg from a real run captured in docs/demo.log (make demo-record). Omitted: repeated
findings, and the Slack and metrics-listener lines. Timestamps shortened to HH:MM:SS; long lines
wrapped; nothing else edited. Telemetry is the simulator and squeue is a fake: no GPUs, no Slurm
controller, no cluster.
